prompt: Our guide told us he (to collect) old bus tickets from local trips.
explanation_ru: Глагол передачи речи стоит в прошедшем времени (told), поэтому Present Simple сдвигается в Past Simple (collected).

prompt: From the noisy kitchen, Tessa shouted that she (to pack) our lunch.
explanation_ru: Действие происходило прямо в момент речи, поэтому после глагола в прошедшем времени (shouted) Present Continuous переходит в Past Continuous.

prompt: Whenever we took the old ferry, Lucas told me he ___ a seat upstairs.
explanation_ru: После глагола told о прошлой привычке нужен сдвиг времени в Past Simple (preferred). Частая ошибка — оставлять настоящее время (prefers).

prompt: Kieran texted from the garden that he (to paint) the gate and (will / to join) us after tea.
explanation_ru: В момент отправки сообщения действие было в процессе (Present Continuous → Past Continuous), а обещание о будущем (will) сдвигается в would.

prompt: My neighbour said me that she walked to the station for exercise.
answer: My neighbour told me that she walked to the station for exercise.
accepted_answers: My neighbour told me that she walked to the station for exercise.
My neighbour told me she walked to the station for exercise.
My neighbour said to me that she walked to the station for exercise.
My neighbour said to me she walked to the station for exercise.
My neighbour said that she walked to the station for exercise.
My neighbour said she walked to the station for exercise.
explanation_ru: Глагол say не используется напрямую с дополнением (нельзя сказать said me): нужен глагол told me либо said to me.

prompt: Daria tells everyone she (to learn) to drive at a local school right now.
explanation_ru: Глагол передачи речи стоит в настоящем времени (tells), поэтому сдвиг времён не нужен — сохраняется Present Continuous (is learning).

prompt: Nobody expected our quiet accountant to be a salsa fan. Last autumn, Rafael mentioned that he (to teach) beginner classes at the old sports hall, which closed in March. I asked about the schedule, and he replied that he (can / to invite) me to a free trial. He promised he (will / to text) the address once the hall reopened.
explanation_ru: После глаголов в прошедшем времени Present Simple переходит в Past Simple (taught), модальный can — в could, а will — в would.

prompt: Sweet smells filled the hall, and Piotr whispered that he (to bake) fresh garlic rolls for the surprise party.
explanation_ru: Запах в коридоре показывает, что процесс шёл прямо тогда, поэтому Present Continuous в косвенной речи сдвигается в Past Continuous (was baking).

prompt: At university, Mei told me she ___ a small flat with her cousin.
explanation_ru: Ситуация относится к прошлому периоду, поэтому после told нужен сдвиг из Present Simple в Past Simple (shared), а не настоящее время.

prompt: Nadia complained, "I never leave the office before seven, so I miss the bus." → Nadia complained that …
answer: Nadia complained that she never left the office before seven, so she missed the bus.
accepted_answers: Nadia complained that she never left the office before seven, so she missed the bus.
Nadia complained that she never left the office before seven so she missed the bus.
explanation_ru: При переводе в косвенную речь после complained местоимение I меняется на she, а оба глагола в Present Simple переходят в Past Simple (left, missed).

prompt: Housing prices in Dublin surprised everyone at the reunion. Seamus explained that he (to look) for a brighter flat near the park. He complained that he (never / to receive) a single reply from three landlords up to that point. Today, Seamus laughs and says he (to love) his tiny attic room.
explanation_ru: В первых двух репликах нужен сдвиг после прошедших глаголов (was looking, had never received), а в конце глагол says стоит в настоящем времени, поэтому сдвига нет (loves).

prompt: Did Samira explain why she missed us? She texted that she (to sort) old photos upstairs and (can / not / to hear) the bell.
explanation_ru: Фоновое действие в момент звонка передаётся через Past Continuous (was sorting), а невозможность услышать (can't) после texted сдвигается в could not hear.

prompt: "Have you spoken to Henrik about August?" "Yes, he phoned from Oslo to tell me he (to plan) a walking trip along the coast. He admitted he (never / to camp) in the hills before. He also joked that his old rucksack (to weigh) more than a suitcase."
explanation_ru: После глаголов в прошедшем времени (phoned, admitted, joked) Present Continuous переходит в Past Continuous, Present Perfect — в Past Perfect, а Present Simple — в Past Simple.

prompt: Over coffee, Dev told me he is saving for a second-hand laptop because his old screen had cracked.
answer: Over coffee, Dev told me he was saving for a second-hand laptop because his old screen had cracked.
accepted_answers: Over coffee, Dev told me he was saving for a second-hand laptop because his old screen had cracked.
Over coffee, Dev told me that he was saving for a second-hand laptop because his old screen had cracked.
explanation_ru: Разговор и вторая часть предложения (had cracked) относятся к прошлому, поэтому после told нужен сдвиг is saving → was saving.

prompt: Once the stalls closed, Olga insisted that she never ___ cheap apples at the big supermarket.
explanation_ru: После глагола insisted в прошедшем времени привычное действие (Present Simple) сдвигается в Past Simple (bought). Ошибка — оставлять buys.

prompt: Rubbing his tired eyes at breakfast, Marek admitted that he (to watch) a history series for hours and (to forget) to set his alarm.
explanation_ru: Длительное действие до момента разговора (for hours) переходит в Past Perfect Continuous (had been watching), а предшествующий факт — в Past Perfect (had forgotten).

prompt: Our headteacher proudly told the parents that she had always read a chapter before breakfast since her student days.
answer: Our headteacher proudly told the parents that she had always read a chapter before breakfast since her student days.
accepted_answers: Our headteacher proudly told the parents that she had always read a chapter before breakfast since her student days.
explanation_ru: Предложение составлено верно: после глагола told время Present Perfect (have always read ... since) правильно сдвинуто в Past Perfect (had always read).

prompt: Rain ruined our Sunday cycling race before it even began. Standing under a shelter, Gareth complained that he (to repair) his gears the evening before for nothing. His teammate Rosa admitted that her front brakes (not / to feel) safe on wet roads anyway. Whenever we meet, Gareth still jokes that the mud (to belong) in a museum.
explanation_ru: Ремонт накануне выражается через Past Perfect (had repaired), состояние в тот момент — через Past Simple (didn't feel), а после глагола в настоящем времени jokes сдвига нет (belongs).

prompt: Though the night train arrived late, Youssef told the receptionist he (to rest) in a quiet compartment for hours and (to expect) to arrive at the conference on time.
explanation_ru: Отдых длился несколько часов до момента разговора (Past Perfect Continuous: had been resting), а ожидание в момент разговора (I expect) сдвигается в Past Simple (expected).

prompt: Zainab lost her purse on a tram on Tuesday, and a passenger handed it in on Wednesday. On Thursday evening, Zainab told a colleague what had happened. Which report fits best?
options: Zainab told her colleague that a passenger was finding her purse the day before.
Zainab told her colleague that a passenger had found her purse the day before.
Zainab told her colleague that a passenger finds her purse on Wednesday.
Zainab told her colleague that a passenger would find her purse the day before.
explanation_ru: Пассажир нашёл кошелёк за день до разговора, поэтому после told нужен Past Perfect (had found). Остальные варианты искажают время или смысл события.

prompt: Smoke drifted out of the flat as I reached the top landing. Coughing slightly, Farid confessed that he (to cook) a spicy stew all afternoon with the fan switched off. He added that the loud alarm (to scare) his cat under the sofa. Before leaving, our neighbour joked that everyone on the floor suddenly (to smell) like fried onions.
explanation_ru: Длительная готовка до разговора переходит в Past Perfect Continuous (had been cooking), случившийся ранее испуг кота — в Past Perfect (had scared), а состояние в момент шутки — в Past Simple.
